## Summary

## Verification

Describe the checks you ran and their results. For documentation-only changes, mark code checks as not applicable.

- [ ] Relevant tests pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] Lint and typecheck pass (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] Tests or documentation were updated where needed.

## Privacy and Security

- [ ] Examples, screenshots, and logs use synthetic or fully redacted data.
- [ ] No personal data, real payslips, credentials, tokens, or Artifact links containing personal or financial data are included.

Report suspected vulnerabilities [privately](https://github.com/cdemeo92/tracking-pension-deductions/security/advisories/new), not in this PR. See the [security policy](https://github.com/cdemeo92/tracking-pension-deductions/security/policy).
